sec.title: August 27 Archival Enrichment (Increment 212)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American and British radio, Charles Collingwood's dramatic live eyewitness reporting of the assassination attempt on General Charles de Gaulle inside Notre-Dame during Paris liberation services, Kenneth Horne in *The Little Things in Life*, two legal crusades with Jay Jostyn on *Mr. District Attorney* for Vitalis, United Press war correspondent Joseph Grigg on *Soldiers of the Press*, and Robert Young & Lurene Tuttle starring in *The Sacrificial Lamb* on *Skippy Hollywood Theatre* for Skippy Peanut Butter (1941–1975):
